series.name: EMEA ESS app error codes (2-digit codes on SolarGo / PV Master, EM / ET / BT)
series.notes: This is the EMEA SolarGo / PV Master 2-digit app code table plus its 'ETU' three-phase variants (e.g. 02ETU, 05ETU, 14ETU). The ETU suffix rows are three-phase-only and do not exist on single-phase units. The same digits mean something completely different in SERIES 3 / 4 / 6 - e.g. app 12 = Internal Fan Failure but ES-US 12 = Abnormal GFCI 30mA, app 13 = Over Temperature but ES-US 13 = Abnormal GFCI 60mA, app 25 = Relay check failure but UT 25 = DC Switch Fail. Never merge with any other GoodWe table.

title.ur: AC HCT check fail - current sensor (01)

meaning.en: The AC current Hall sensor self-check failed, from an external magnetic field or an internal component fault.
meaning.ur: AC current Hall sensor ka self-check fail hua, wajah koi external magnetic field ya internal component fault hai.

causes.en: Intermittent fault caused by an external magnetic field.
causes.ur: External magnetic field ki wajah se intermittent fault.

causes.en: An internal component is faulty.
causes.ur: Koi internal component kharab hai.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and see if the code returns; a one-off is an intermittent fault.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke code wapas aata hai ya nahi, aik baar aana intermittent fault hai.

solutions.en: Keep steel, a transformer or a large motor away from the AC cable run and the inverter.
solutions.ur: Steel, transformer ya bada motor AC cable aur inverter se door rakhein.

solutions.en: If it returns, contact the service centre for board-level repair.
solutions.ur: Agar dobara aaye to board level repair ke liye service centre se rabta karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

meaning.en: Grid-side failure family: no grid power, AC not connected, or AC breaker not working. The guide lists 09, 17 and 29 together.
meaning.ur: Grid side ki failure family: grid power nahi, AC connect nahi, ya AC breaker kaam nahi kar raha. Guide mein 09, 17 aur 29 ek saath hain.

causes.en: Grid power failure.
causes.ur: Grid power fail ho gayi.

causes.en: AC is not connected well.
causes.ur: AC theek se connect nahi hai.

causes.en: AC breaker fails.
causes.ur: AC breaker kharab hai.

causes.en: Grid is not connected.
causes.ur: Grid connect nahi hai.

solutions.en: Make sure grid power is actually available at the site.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke site par grid power mojood hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, check the AC terminals have the correct voltage.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se check karein ke AC terminals par sahi voltage hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check all terminations throughout the AC path are tight.
solutions.ur: AC path ke tamam terminations tight hain ya nahi check karein.

solutions.en: Turn the AC breaker off, wait 5 minutes, then turn it on again.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karein, 5 minute intezaar karein, phir dobara on karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

meaning.en: Neutral and ground are not bonded correctly at the AC terminals, or PV panel leakage to ground is high, or the utility ground was lost.
meaning.ur: AC terminals par neutral aur ground theek se bonded nahi, ya PV panel ka ground se leakage zyada hai, ya utility ka ground chala gaya.

causes.en: Neutral and ground cables not well connected on AC terminals.
causes.ur: AC terminals par neutral aur ground cables theek se nahi lage.

causes.en: Solar panel leakage current to ground in humid conditions.
causes.ur: Nam mahaul mein solar panel ka ground se leakage current.

causes.en: Utility ground loss.
causes.ur: Utility ka ground chala gaya.

solutions.en: With a multimeter, measure voltage between earth and the inverter frame; it should be close to 0V.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se earth aur inverter frame ke darmiyan voltage measure karein, 0V ke qareeb hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Confirm N and PE are properly terminated at the AC terminal block.
solutions.ur: AC terminal block par N aur PE theek se terminate hain ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: If it only shows on rainy days, it is PV panel leakage - re-check the string insulation.
solutions.ur: Agar sirf barsaat ke din aaye to PV panel leakage hai, string insulation dobara check karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

aliases: Internal Fan Failure (Back-Up Over Load for ES)

title.ur: Internal fan kharab ya back-up overload (12)

meaning.en: On ES the same code means the back-up loads exceed the inverter output; on other lines it means the internal fan is blocked or its cable is loose.
meaning.ur: ES par yehi code ka matlab hai back-up load inverter output se zyada hai; doosri lines par matlab internal fan band hai ya us ka cable dhila hai.

causes.en: On ES, back-up loads exceed the inverter maximum output.
causes.ur: ES par back-up load inverter ke maximum output se zyada hai.

causes.en: Internal fan is blocked by something.
causes.ur: Kisi cheez se internal fan block hai.

causes.en: Fan cable not connected well in the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter mein fan cable theek se nahi lagi.

solutions.en: Reduce the loads on the back-up output and restart.
solutions.ur: Back-up output par load kam karke restart karein.

solutions.en: Open the unit and check nothing is obstructing the fan impeller.
solutions.ur: Unit kholein aur check karein ke fan impeller mein koi cheez nahi atki hui.

solutions.en: Re-seat the fan cable connector at the control board.
solutions.ur: Control board par fan cable connector dobara lagayein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

meaning.en: Ambient around the inverter has been too hot for long enough, or the airflow is obstructed.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke aas paas ka ambient bohat der tak garm raha, ya airflow mein rok hai.

causes.en: Air temperature around the inverter too high for an extended period.
causes.ur: Inverter ke aas paas ka temperature lambi der tak zyada raha.

causes.en: Installation location does not give enough airflow for cooling.
causes.ur: Installation jagah cooling ke liye kaafi airflow nahi de rahi.

causes.en: Obstruction of airflow around the inverter.
causes.ur: Inverter ke aas paas airflow mein rok hai.

solutions.en: Try to reduce the surrounding temperature - shade the unit, improve room ventilation.
solutions.ur: Surrounding temperature kam karne ki koshish karein, unit ko shadow dein, room ventilation behtar karein.

solutions.en: Ensure the installation complies with the manual and there is clearance for the cooling system.
solutions.ur: Ensure karein ke installation manual ke mutabiq hai aur cooling system ke liye jagah hai.

solutions.en: Clear any obstruction from the cooling fins.
solutions.ur: Cooling fins mein koi rok hua ho to saaf kar dein.

solutions.en: Switch the inverter off for 15 minutes, then switch it on again.
solutions.ur: Inverter 15 minute ke liye band karke dobara on karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

meaning.en: The open-circuit voltage of a PV string is above the inverter's maximum DC input voltage.
meaning.ur: Kisi PV string ka open-circuit voltage inverter ke maximum DC input voltage se zyada hai.

causes.en: Total open-circuit voltage of the string exceeds max DC input voltage.
causes.ur: String ka total open-circuit voltage max DC input voltage se zyada hai.

causes.en: Too many modules in series for cold-morning Voc rise.
causes.ur: Series mein modules zyada hain, thande subah Voc barh jata hai.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and measure each string's Voc with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: DC switch off karke har string ka Voc multimeter se measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare the reading against the inverter's max DC input voltage printed on the label.
solutions.ur: Reading ko inverter ke label par likhe max DC input voltage se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of series modules so cold-morning Voc stays below the limit.
solutions.ur: Series modules ki sankhya kam karein taake thande subah ki Voc limit se neeche rahe.

solutions.en: Use the EZ designer temperature-coefficient calculation to verify the string design.
solutions.ur: String design verify karne ke liye EZ designer ka temperature coefficient calculation use karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

meaning.en: The relay self-test found a fault; the guide points at N/PE bonding at the AC terminals or utility ground loss.
meaning.ur: Relay self-test ne fault paya, guide AC terminals par N/PE bonding ya utility ground loss ki taraf ishara karta hai.

causes.en: Neutral and ground cables not well connected on AC terminals.
causes.ur: AC terminals par neutral aur ground cables theek se nahi lage.

causes.en: Utility ground loss.
causes.ur: Utility ka ground chala gaya.

solutions.en: Measure voltage between ground and neutral on the grid; it must be under 10V.
solutions.ur: Grid par ground aur neutral ke darmiyan voltage measure karein, 10V se kam hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Measure resistance between ground and neutral on the backup output; it must be under 10 ohm.
solutions.ur: Backup output par ground aur neutral ke darmiyan resistance measure karein, 10 ohm se kam hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Re-terminate the N and PE conductors at the AC terminal and retest.
solutions.ur: AC terminal par N aur PE conductors dobara terminate karke dobara test karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

meaning.en: The battery activation/licence code configured in the app is not correct for the fitted battery.
meaning.ur: App mein set kiya hua battery activation/licence code fitted battery ke liye theek nahi hai.

causes.en: Battery activation code incorrect.
causes.ur: Battery activation code ghalat hai.

causes.en: Battery type selected in the app does not match the installed pack (listed in the same guide's battery-communication fault list).
causes.ur: App mein select kiya hua battery type installed pack se match nahi karta, ye bhi isi guide ki battery communication fault list mein hai.

solutions.en: Check the battery model selected in the app matches the battery physically installed.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke app mein select kiya hua battery model asal mein lagi battery se match karta hai.

solutions.en: Read the battery protocol code and serial from the battery and re-enter them in the app.
solutions.ur: Battery se protocol code aur serial parhein aur app mein dohra daal karein.

solutions.en: Contact the service centre for the correct licence string for that battery pack.
solutions.ur: Us battery pack ke liye sahi licence string ke liye service centre se rabta karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message

meaning.en: The control board storage chip could not be read or written, so stored settings may be lost.
meaning.ur: Control board ka storage chip read ya write nahi ho raha, is liye stored settings kho sakte hain.

causes.en: Intermittent fault caused by an external magnetic field.
causes.ur: External magnetic field ki wajah se intermittent fault.

causes.en: Control board storage chip read/write failure.
causes.ur: Control board ke storage chip ki read/write failure.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter and check whether the error returns.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein aur dekhein ke error wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Update the inverter DSP firmware locally from the app.
solutions.ur: App se inverter ka DSP firmware locally update karein.

solutions.en: Back up and note all settings before a firmware update, then contact the service centre if it persists.
solutions.ur: Firmware update se pehle tamam settings note kar lein, phir agar masla rahe to service centre se rabta karein.

source.title: GW ESS Troubleshooting Guide EMEA EN, section 4.3 Troubleshootings for Each Error Message
